name: stet
title: Stet
description: A copywriter's portfolio typed on canary copy paper: every piece opens with a typed slug of client, date and what it was for, its headline double-underlined in an editor's blue pencil, and it closes with a centred ENDS — built for work that is words, not pictures.

tokens.--font-type: the one typewriter typeface used for everything — names, headlines, copy, labels and code
tokens.--text-s: size of the footer line and of code blocks
tokens.--text-m: size of body text, the slug, the menu and section headings in page text — the typewriter's one size
tokens.--text-l: size of the headline of each piece in a list of work or posts
tokens.--text-xl: size of page titles, the home page statement and the headline of a project or post page
tokens.--leading-copy: line height of the typed copy under a headline — double spacing, as copy is typed
tokens.--leading-body: line height of page text, the slug and code; also the blank line left under the slug
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of titles and headlines
tokens.--weight-strike: boldness of the name, titles, headlines and section headings — an overstruck key
tokens.--color-bg: page background — the canary copy paper
tokens.--color-text: typed text: copy, headlines, the slug, the menu and the name
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text — the footer line, years in the run-down of work, pagination, empty messages and the break mark
tokens.--color-accent: the editor's blue pencil — the double underline under headlines, the rings round ENDS and the current menu entry, links, the margin line beside a quotation, focus rings and text selection
tokens.--color-rule: typed hyphen rules under the masthead and over the footer, dashed table rules and the hairline round pictures
tokens.--measure: width of the copy sheet — the column every piece is typed in
tokens.--side-min: narrowest the left-hand margin column may be on wide screens, where page titles and the home page statement sit
tokens.--tab-stop: the tab stop in the slug: where the client, date and services start after their labels
tokens.--indent: the paragraph indent of typed copy, also the indent of lists and quotations
tokens.--gutter: the page margin left and right
tokens.--desk-gap: the gap between the margin column and the copy sheet on wide screens
tokens.--space-1: spacing scale — hairline: between list items
tokens.--space-2: spacing scale — tight: padding of menu entries and rows in the run-down of work
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale — base: between paragraphs, under headlines, around ENDS
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy: above section headings and under a page headline
tokens.--space-5: spacing scale — section: between pieces and above the page
tokens.--space-6: spacing scale — the empty paper above the footer
tokens.--pencil-weight: thickness of each blue-pencil stroke: the double underline, the rings, the margin line beside a quotation, the focus ring and a link's underline while hovered
tokens.--ring-tilt: how far the hand-drawn ring round the current menu entry leans (the ring round ENDS leans half as far the other way)
tokens.--dash: length of each hyphen in a typed rule (a typed character is 1ch wide)
tokens.--cover-max-height: tallest the picture at the top of a project page may be
